traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text:
The bat can’t use its blindsight while
deafened.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text:
The bat doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks
when it flies out of an enemies reach.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.text:
The bat has advantage on Wisdom
(Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft.,
one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 +2) piercing damage.
